photos.c: BOTTOM RIGHT: Alan Black who set a new Club Steeplechase record of 9:20.0 in the Scottish Championships. Shortly after this he fractured an ankle and has only just resumed training.
Alan Black leads the senior mile field.
Alan Black (1) takes the water jump in the A.A.A. v. L.U. match. Alan (9:35.2) finished 2nd to Ben Grubb (6). For a picture of Alan next time round see page 22.
(See Page 18) Alan Black takes a dive and gives his first A.A.A. vest a drenching during the A.A.A./London University match at Motspur Park. Perhaps it should have been an A.S.A. vest!

The Brighton in PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Pat Newell takes the baton from Bill Kerr to set off on Stage 10 with a 2 minutes lead. TOP RIGHT: Laurie O'Hara gives Gerry North the lead we all hoped for---46 secs over Portsmouth after 7 stages. John Davies, behind, takes a time-check. CENTRE LEFT: That long stretch of empty road behind Gerry North lengthens with every stride. CENTRE RIGHT:Bill Kerr clocks fastest time on Stage 9---the longest at 6 miles-52 yards. BOTTOM LEFT: The picture Eddie Lacey has waited 22 'Brightons' for---Belgrave crossing the line 3mins-10secs ahead of Portsmouth. BOTTOM RIGHT:Alan Black hands the presentation baton to the Mayor of Brighton Councillor S.D. Deason J.P. Photos by E.D.L. & R.L.

THE WINNING LONDON-BRIGHTON RELAY TEAM (Southern Event) ON THE SEA-FRONT WITH THE PRESIDENT AND THE "NEWS OF THE WORLD" TROPHY. REAR:(L.toR.) P. Newell, W.Kerr,Geoff.North,R.Linstead,The President, A.Fairclough,B.Sawyer,C. Dabbs. FRONT:(L.toR.)J.Thresher,Gerald North,L.O'Hara,A. Black. (C.W. Walker was not present).

TOP LEFT: Bill Kerr trails Bullivant and Tulloh on Stage 9. TOP RIGHT: John Thresher hands over to a determined Trevor Hart after stage 2. CENTRE: Alan Mead and 'Noddy' Edwards, with some female assistance, cheer on the runners! BOTTOM LEFT: Laurie O'Hara hands over to Gerry North after chopping 17 secs off the Club record for stage 7. BOTTOM RIGHT: Alan Black brings Belgrave home in 4th place.
Gerry North and Alan Black lead Geoff North (1), O'Hara (5), Thorpe (18), Fairclough (16) and Dabbs (27) shortly after the start.
PHOTO (E.Lacey) Gough forces his way past Black a few feet from the finishing line. For several minutes afterwards the Portsmouth runner was in a state of collapse due to his courageous effort.
My picture shows Bill (far right) alongside Chris Steer, our President Bob Taylor, Trevor Hart and Alan Black; with the two Norths and Dabbs in the front row.
CENTRE: A confident team await the start. (L to R): Black,Merry,Geoff North Gerry North,Dear,Steer,Major and Dabbs.
Pat O'Connor leads from Alan Black, Dick Piotrowski and Roger Donnison

PHOTO ACTION AT NATIONAL LEAGUE. TOP LEFT: Dick Piotrowski heads for a ducking in the S/chase, but surfaced to go on to finish 3rd. in 9:30.8 TOP RIGHT: In the 'B' S/chase Alan Black sets the pace and also secured 3rd. position. BOTTOM LEFT: Adrian Major runs at the shoulder of Don Faircloth (Croydon) in the 'A' 5000 metres before he too finished 3rd. BOTTOM RIGHT: In the 'B' 5000 metres Laurie O'Hara proved too good for most of the second strings and he is seen here finishing 2nd.
Alan Black leads Fearon (H/W) over the water jump
The debonair Alan Black avoids getting his feet wet again.

The Belgrave 20 Mile Road Race. Centre: Graham Taylor (Camb H), the winner. Top left to right: Geoff Pearson, George Piddington, Alan Black and Trevor Hart. Bottom: John Davies, Bob Richardson and Charlie Henn.
Bottom right: Alan Black ran well to be third Belgrave scorer.
Back Cover: Jim Rimmer (keeping his shorts up on this occasion) lea[illegible] Leo Coy and Alan Black in the Surrey Cross Country Champs.
Alan Black who returned to win the club s/chase is closely shadowed by the ubiquitous Tom Dowdall
The field sets out for the Christmas 1996 running of The Paarlauf. Bunched on the lefthand side are Dave Beaver, Roger Alsop, Marcello Bizio, Alan Black and Charlie Dickinson.
Right:Suzy and Leo Coy, Denny Manning, Snowy Brooks, Don Turner, Alan Black (obscured), Alan Mead, Charlie Henn and Marianne Black listen to the speeches.

Left: Enjoying the occasion.  Pat Mead, Tony Binda, Marianne Black, Gerry North, Alan Black, the late Laurie O'Hara, George Piddington, Charlie Henn, Ted Pallant, Chris Steer, Charlie Manning.

Sadly this was the last time that we saw Laurie O'Hara.  He died the following day while out running.

Left: Part of the Belgrave T&F Team of '67 pose with President Frank Jarvis at the end of a successful season.
Back row: Brian King (throws), Chris Keavey (middle distance), Bill Couzens (throws), Don McLean (middle-distance and steeplechase), Frank Jarvis, Nick Head (javelin), Bob Taylor (Team Manager), Bill Dance (middle distance), Adrian Major (middle distance), Alan Black (middle-distance and steeplechase).
Front: John Mitchell (long jump and sprints), Phil Smith sprints John Martin (throws), Tony Brooks (440/880), Alan Mead 440/880).
